title: Empowering Youth in AI Governance
query: How does AI4IA discuss youth empowerment and AI governance?
summary: The AI4IA conference emphasizes the importance of empowering youth to shape the future of AI and ensuring their voices are heard in policy development. This involves providing them with the right skills, ethical frameworks, and platforms for innovation. By doing so, young people can become architects of a smart and just future, rather than just its subjects.
